items.title: Tom Albert Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: I played with them too. He had a little fellow playing with him... So I went round there and... Jack Fajida. He used to play with the old man, Johnny.

ctx.x: Who was the leader of that?

Joe, Joe, Joe Lizard. Joe Lizard. He was the leader of the Excelsior band. Yeah, I know the band, but they used to wear green suits. What kind of suits did Henry Allen's band wear? Well we used to wear, we used to have them kind of a, we used to wear white pants and blue pants, you know, all white atlas we played. Then we, for funeral, we'll have a blue, no we'd have a blue blouse and white. You understand? For funeral we'll have a black shirt and blue pants. Oh, I see. Yeah, you look darker color.
